policies.name: live_sessions_authorized_insert
policies.check: (is_admin() OR ((faculty_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND teacher_has_assignment(NULL::uuid, program_id, subject_id, NULL::text)))

policies.name: live_sessions_scoped_read
policies.qual:
(is_admin() OR (faculty_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM enrollments e
  WHERE ((e.batch_id = live_sessions.batch_id) AND (e.student_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (e.status = 'active'::enrollment_status)))))
